general.notes: Copper 2.5GBASE-T/RJ-45 module; not an optical transceiver. Cable reach stated as 100 m (Cat 6a / Table 5); no reach_km value given. Features cite max power dissipation 2.5 W; Table 1 supply-current note cites 1.2 W max over full voltage and temperature range; caution states power consumption exceeds SFP MSA. +3.3V section text states input voltage range +5 V +/- 5% while Table 1 defines Vcc 3.13–3.47 V and disallows 3.3 V max for continuous operation in adjacent text—wording inconsistent. Applications: Cat 6A/7 and Cat 5e cable; not fiber. LOS pin described per standard worst-case sensitivity, no dBm thresholds in this datasheet. Data rate Table 5: 1000–2500 Mb/sec IEEE 802.3 compatible.
general.suggestions: Add reach_m or cable_length_m for copper modules; allow SFP/SFP+ in form_factor enum; optional fields for line_frequency_mhz (800 MHz max, 5-level encoding) and supply current.
